faqs.q: Where and how is the 1-1/2" (DN40) high-pressure hydraulic ball valve used?
faqs.a: This is the 1-1/2" (DN40) high-pressure ball valve for hydraulic circuits: pump, accumulator and return-line isolation where a process ball valve's rating runs out. The valves we list in this size are rated 4,570 to 6,000 psi.

faqs.q: What sizes and part numbers are listed for the 1-1/2" (DN40) high-pressure hydraulic ball valve?
faqs.a: The 1-1/2" (DN40) high-pressure hydraulic ball valve is listed as a single nominal size, 1-1/2 in (DN40), covering the valves we have photographed in that size, with ends BSP (G 1-1/2), SAE flange (6,000 psi) and SAE flange. Give the size, pressure rating, end connection, body and seat material on the enquiry, with a make and part number if you have one, and we confirm lead time and documentation on the quotation.

faqs.q: How should I select the 1-1/2" (DN40) high-pressure hydraulic ball valve for my application?
faqs.a: Give the size, the working pressure, the end connection, the body and seat material and, if you have one, the make and part number. The 1-1/2" (DN40) high-pressure hydraulic ball valve is quoted to the specification on your enquiry, so name the fluid and temperature as well, because ratings fall as temperature rises.

faqs.q: What pressure rating does the 1-1/2" (DN40) high-pressure hydraulic ball valve have?
faqs.a: The valves listed under the 1-1/2" (DN40) high-pressure hydraulic ball valve are rated 4,570 to 6,000 psi, and the table on the listing gives each one as marked. PN is the pressure in bar at 20 °C, so PN350 is 5,075 psi and PN400 is 5,800 psi; WOG is the cold working pressure for water, oil and gas, and MAWP the maximum allowable working pressure. Tell us your working pressure and fluid and we match the valve.

faqs.q: What is the 1-1/2" (DN40) high-pressure hydraulic ball valve made from?
faqs.a: The valves listed under the 1-1/2" (DN40) high-pressure hydraulic ball valve have stainless steel or steel bodies, as marked on each (the listing gives Carbon steel, Steel, 316L stainless (A479)). The usual seat is POM, an acetal that suits hydraulic oil; say if your fluid or temperature needs another seat material.

faqs.q: Which standards apply to the 1-1/2" (DN40) high-pressure hydraulic ball valve?
faqs.a: The listing gives ratings as marked on the valves, in PN, WOG and psi, and names no ISO or API standard for the 1-1/2" (DN40) high-pressure hydraulic ball valve. SAE flange ends are rated by code: Code 61 for 3,000 psi service and Code 62 for 6,000 psi. Ask in the enquiry for any documentation you need, and we confirm it on the quotation.

faqs.q: What does the 1-1/2" (DN40) high-pressure hydraulic ball valve connect to?
faqs.a: The 1-1/2" (DN40) high-pressure hydraulic ball valve is supplied with ends to suit your system, for example BSP (G 1-1/2), SAE flange (6,000 psi) and SAE flange. SAE flange ends need the matching flange and seal; threaded ends need the matching adapter. See [our hydraulic ball valve shelf](/c/hydraulic-ball-valves) for the other sizes.

faqs.q: How should the 1-1/2" (DN40) high-pressure hydraulic ball valve be installed and maintained?
faqs.a: Fit the 1-1/2" (DN40) high-pressure hydraulic ball valve with the pressure rating and the end connection matched to the line, turn the lever through a quarter turn and do not use it to throttle. Check for weeping at the stem after the first pressure cycle, and size the lever clearance before mounting, because high-pressure valves are heavy.

faqs.q: Which industries and jobs use the 1-1/2" (DN40) high-pressure hydraulic ball valve?
faqs.a: The 1-1/2" (DN40) high-pressure hydraulic ball valve is used for pump, accumulator and return-line isolation in hydraulic circuits where a process ball valve's rating runs out, on presses, power units, accumulators and test rigs.

faqs.q: How does the 1-1/2" (DN40) high-pressure hydraulic ball valve differ from the 2" (DN50) high-pressure hydraulic ball valve?
faqs.a: The 1-1/2" (DN40) listing covers valves rated 4,570 to 6,000 psi, while [the 2" (DN50) high-pressure hydraulic ball valve](/p/high-pressure-hydraulic-ball-valve-2-inch) covers valves rated 3,000 psi. Both are quarter-turn ball valves for hydraulic circuits; choose the size for the flow and then the rating for the pressure.
